rationale: Enabling fuzzy matching must not stop exact terms matching.
Term matching is case-insensitive, so a term the document writes in uppercase is still found when the policy writes it in mixed case.
The span reports the text as it appears in the document, not the casing of the term that matched it. A span has to index its own text for offsets and text to stay usable together.
A single deleted character matches at medium sensitivity.

cases.text: the project is Bluebrid and it ships

expect.filtered_text: the project is Bluebrid and it ships

rationale: A transposition does not match at medium sensitivity, even though a deletion does.

Pinned as current behaviour rather than as obviously correct: the edit-distance threshold and which edits count are exactly what drifts between implementations, so the corpus has to state it explicitly.
